title: 64′ Flybridge Motor Yacht: Miami-Based Luxury Cruiser
description: 2014 64ft flybridge in Miami: twin CAT C18s, dual Seakeepers and joystick control for stable, precise handling.
html:
Moored in Miami, this 64-foot flybridge motor yacht from 2014 blends performance-oriented engineering with refined Italian styling, making it well suited for extended weekend escapes or a charter schedule in South Florida and the nearby Bahamas. At 64 ft (19.51 m) and a 4.92 ft draft, the hull balances seakeeping and marina accessibility, while a maximum speed of about 33 knots gives brisk passage-making when desired. Notable equipment includes twin CAT C18 main engines, twin Seakeeper gyrostabilizers for onboard comfort underway and at anchor, and helm conveniences such as a yacht controller and joystick for precise docking. A full teak exterior package complements the lines and elevates the onboard entertaining areas.

Three-Cabin Layout and Onboard Accommodation Details

The interior is arranged to sleep guests comfortably in three cabins, typically accommodating six aboard, with thoughtful circulation between social spaces and private cabins; natural light and sightlines are emphasized for an open, inviting feel. The main salon provides a relaxed living area for conversation and dining, while the galley and service zones are positioned to support both private cruising and commercial use. Storage, HVAC distribution and system access have been laid out to support longer stays aboard, and heads and crew access are organized to preserve guest privacy. Finishes and joinery reflect a cohesive design language that pairs well with the exterior teak.

Performance, Propulsion and Modern Systems Upgrades

Twin Caterpillar C18 engines deliver reliable power and a responsive ride, with a reported top speed near 33 knots and a propulsion package designed for efficient cruising; the relatively shallow 4.92 ft draft helps in coastal and shallow-anchorage conditions. Stability is markedly improved by the dual Seakeeper units, reducing roll and improving comfort at anchor or underway, while the yacht controller and helm joystick simplify close-quarters handling for a single skipper or short-handed crew. Electrical and navigation systems are specified to support extended cruises; prospective buyers should review service records for recent maintenance and any electronic upgrades.

Exterior Amenities: Teak Decks, Hydraulic Swim Platform

The yacht’s full teak package extends across the decks and swim platform, creating a warm, slip-resistant surface ideal for entertaining and al fresco dining; teak also contributes to the visual continuity between cockpit, side decks and flybridge. The hydraulic swim platform offers easy water access, tender launching capabilities and lowered boarding for watersports, while the flybridge provides generous seating and sunpad configurations for daytime cruising and evening gatherings. A well-proportioned aft deck transitions smoothly from cockpit seating to the swim platform, offering flexible spaces for guests to relax or prepare for activities on the water.

Crew Quarters, Charter Readiness and Leasing Options

A dedicated crew quarters area supports professional operation, with separate access to service the vessel while preserving guest privacy—features that make the yacht appealing for charter operators or owners who plan to carry crew. The overall fit and outfitting reflect a vessel that can be prepared for commercial use, subject to regulatory compliance and survey, and there is a leasing option available for those not ready to purchase outright. Based in Miami, the yacht is conveniently positioned for seasonal charters and logistical support, though prospective operators should confirm flag, certification and insurance requirements for intended trading areas.

Key Takeaways and Next Steps to Explore This Yacht

This 64-foot flybridge motor yacht presents a compelling package: three-cabin guest accommodation plus crew quarters, twin CAT C18 propulsion with joystick and yacht controller for ease of handling, dual Seakeepers for improved comfort, and a full teak exterior with hydraulic swim platform for versatile water access and entertaining. If the blend of performance, stabilisation, and guest-friendly layout aligns with your cruising or charter plans, the next step is to request full specifications, service records and a walkthrough—either virtually or in person—to verify condition and confirm fit for purpose.
